source.title: Empagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease

consistency_findings: One publication_id is shared across article- and protocol-derived atoms; protocol batching does not create a second publication.
Primary-outcome figures/tables and prose report concordant event counts and hazard ratio.
Low-albuminuria subgroup estimates are retained separately from eGFR-slope evidence; absence of a precise primary-outcome benefit in UACR <30 mg/g is not converted into a null long-term slope effect.
Final Trial Protocol v2.0 and Final Data Analysis Plan v1.2 are treated as operative methodological sources; older embedded versions are retained only as version history.
extraction_limitations: The target Drive packet did not contain the separate Supplementary Appendix cited by the article. Supplementary Tables S1-S10 and Figures S1-S7 therefore could not be directly inspected or atomized.
Protocol/DAP content can support prespecified methods but does not substitute for unavailable supplementary results.
Atoms extracted by a language model remain marked needs_review; validation establishes structural/schema/sufficiency validity, not independent factual verification.
